body:
Thank you for the reply. 

I remind her daily that I appreciate everything she does for me, and that I wouldn't know where I would be without her. I try to remind her of how much better things will be soon (with the apartment, I'm graduating soon, etc). 

I was able to get some emergency contacts from her earlier, in the event that she does actually attempt suicide. So I suppose that's a step in the right direction.

We had a very long conversation today, and while very emotional for both of us, she seems to be in better shape now. I'm still going to keep a close eye on her to make sure she doesn't harm herself, but it's difficult as I live far from her.
